title: HB 951 (2009 Regular Session): Voter ID; enact.
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id)
(section) Sec. 1(1)(a)
(quote) Except as provided in subsection (2), a qualified elector who votes in a primary or general election, either in person at the polls or in person in the office of the circuit clerk, shall present a government issued photo identification before being allowed to vote.
(section) Sec. 1(2)(a)
(quote) An elector living and voting in a state-licensed care facility shall not be required to show a government issued photo identification before being allowed to vote.
(b_no_id_remedy)
(section) Sec. 1(1)(b)
(quote) A qualified elector who does not have a government issued photo identification and who cannot afford such identification may obtain a state issued photo identification free of charge from the Mississippi Department of Public Safety.
(section) Sec. 1(2)(b)
(quote) An elector who has a religious objection to being photographed will be allowed to cast a provisional ballot, and the elector, within five (5) days after the election, shall execute an affidavit in the appropriate circuit clerk's office affirming that the exemption applies.
(section) Sec. 1(2)(c)
(quote) An elector who has a government issued photo identification, but is unable to present that identification when voting, shall file a provisional ballot, and the elector, within five (5) days after the election, shall present the government issued photo identification to the appropriate circuit clerk.
(c_mail_ballot_id)
(section) Sec. 4 (23-15-719)
(quote) The registrar shall identify the applicant by requiring him to present identification as required by Section 1 of House Bill No._____, 2009 Regular Session, and then deliver the ballots to the applicant by mail or to the applicant in the registrar's office.
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(e_other_rule)
(section) Sec. 1(3)
(quote) This provision shall not be construed to require photo identification to register to vote.
(other) Sec. 2: 23-15-11 conformed (citizen of the United States, residency, qualified elector)
(other) Sec. 3-4: 23-15-541 and 23-15-719 conformed
(other) Sec. 5-6: preclearance, effective date
